result.note: Tests the scheduled Macron visit itinerary, the 1998 origin of the strategic partnership and the Horizon 2047 roadmap; the likely deliverables are skipped as speculative.

questions.prompt: In February 2026, India's Ministry of External Affairs announced a three-day visit by French President Emmanuel Macron. Consider the following statements:
items: The India–France strategic partnership dates back to 1998.
Macron was scheduled to arrive in Mumbai to launch the India-France Year of Innovation.
The AI Impact Summit was scheduled to be held in Mumbai on 19 February 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because Macron was to head from Mumbai to New Delhi for the AI Impact Summit on 19 February. France stayed a consistent partner even when India faced international sanctions, and the relationship rests on strategic autonomy.
questions.source: Macron will arrive in Mumbai to launch the India-France Year of Innovation before heading to New Delhi for the AI Impact Summit on February 19

questions.prompt: "Horizon 2047", a 25-year roadmap covering defence co-production, AI governance and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific, guides India's partnership with which country?
questions.explain: Horizon 2047 is designed to align Paris and New Delhi on defence co-production, AI governance and Indo-Pacific maritime security. Macron's February 2026 visit to India was built on it, as ties shift from buyer–seller defence deals towards jointly shaping rules, standards and R&D.
questions.source: The visit leans on "Horizon 2047", a 25-year roadmap designed to align Paris and New Delhi on defence co-production, AI governance, and maritime security in the Indo-Pacific.
